description: Every 4 hours, summarizes conversations the Stop hook marked dirty into the keyword-searchable memory index under tmp/memory. Skips conversations still active, shorter than two user turns, subagent trajectories, and conversations this system created itself. Batches all pending work into a single agent conversation per run. The script path is relative to this directory, which install.sh symlinks into the config tree, so it resolves back into the repo.
